pp1.6:2.1: puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati, tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti phalesu ca vasībhāvaṃ:
pp1.6:2.2: atth' ekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati, na ca tattha sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti na ca phalesu vasībhāvaṃ:
pp1.6:2.3: atth' ekacco pugalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati, ditth' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti sāvakapāramiñ ca pāpuṇāti:
pp1.6:2.4: atth' ekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati, ditth' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti na ca sāvakapāramiṃ pāpuṇāti:
pp1.6:2.5: atth' ekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati, diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti anāgāmī hoti anāgantvā itthattaṃ:
pp1.6:2.6: atth' ekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati, na ca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti sakadāgāmī hoti āgantvā itthattaṃ. 1.
